metrics.label: Trust
metrics.description: Comfort, relaxation, safety, reliability, and predictability across automated-driving contexts.

metrics.label: Adoption intention
metrics.description: Intention to use, use with access, use on everyday trips, and buy a conditionally automated car.

metrics.label: Safety confidence
metrics.description: Inverse of concerns about safety, malfunctions, and resuming control after other activities.

metrics.label: Expected benefits
metrics.description: Expected usefulness, safer arrival, and greater comfort.

metrics.label: Prior awareness
metrics.description: Share who had heard of automated cars before the questionnaire.

metrics.label: Secondary-activity willingness
metrics.description: Willingness to use automated-driving time for other activities.

metrics.label: L3 capability knowledge
metrics.description: Share of answered capability statements classified correctly after the survey introduction.

provenance.countryLabels: country_label from attached l3pilot_clean_countries.json; UK and USA normalized to map display names United Kingdom and United States.
provenance.sevenCriteria: Original seven map criteria retained. Five Likert-derived metrics are converted back from the prior 0-100 linear normalization to the original 1-5 scale. Prior awareness and L3 capability knowledge remain percentages because they are not Likert measures.
provenance.codeMappingValidation: All 17 country-code respondent counts matched between the attached country-labeled respondent dataset and the original full metric aggregation.
provenance.tripPurposeSpider: Per-country and pooled global means for commute, business travel, errands, leisure, and vacation. Each item excludes missing/non-scale responses independently and reports its valid n.
